cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. That ink on your new sofa must be from the delivery label.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The label's dry. You signed with your fountain pen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then the driver brushed my signature against the fabric. We should photograph it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your pen's still leaking onto the cushion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The delivery must have cracked it when they squeezed past me. Photograph the pen too; that's a second claim.

mechanism: A directs the evidence-gathering and claim so each clue implicating A becomes another accusation against the delivery.
confusable: Unlike an ordinary complaint, A revises blame as increasingly direct evidence points to A's leaking pen.
comparison: Sofa ink and a second pen claim differ from a shelf bracket and self-drawn arrow.
seedUse: The seed already orders photos and declares a second claim; S01 makes that control over the explanation explicit.
